Diligent cannot read this setting on this phone. Check it in Developer options:
1. Open Settings, then About phone, and tap Build number seven times.\n2. Go back and open Developer options (under System on some phones).\n3. Turn on Disable child process restrictions.

Android 12 and 13 stop extra programs your tasks start once there are more than 32. Only a computer can lift this limit: turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options, connect with adb, then run these commands in order.

Run heavy projects on your laptop and see them on the phone. The phone connects to the laptop with SSH, using a key instead of a password.
1. Turn on SSH on the laptop
macOS: System Settings, General, Sharing, then turn on Remote Login.
Linux: install and start openssh-server, for example sudo apt install openssh-server.

You need its address and your username on it. The address is its Wi-Fi IP address (macOS: System Settings, Wi-Fi, Details; Linux: hostname -I) or its Tailscale name. The username is what whoami prints in the laptop\'s terminal.
2. Let the laptop accept this phone
The phone needs an SSH key. Diligent uses the one in ~/.ssh, or makes one.
Paste this line into a terminal on the laptop:
No laptop yet. Add one, then tap Test.
Running on the laptop needs Git there. On macOS it comes with the Xcode Command Line Tools; on Linux, install the git package.
Can\'t reach %1$s. Is it awake and on the same network or Tailscale?
%1$s answered but did not accept the phone\'s key. Run the command above on the laptop, then test again.
%1$s answered with a different host key than before. If the laptop was reinstalled, remove its line from ~/.ssh/known_hosts in the terminal.
A short name on one line, for example mac.
Wi-Fi IP address or Tailscale name
Your login name on the laptop
To run a project there, set \"where\": \"laptop:NAME\" in its .diligent/run.json, or tap Run on NAME instead on the Run screen when Diligent offers it.
This phone is not on Wi-Fi or a hotspot. Join the same network as %1$s, or turn on Tailscale on both.
%1$s was not found on this network. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi and Diligent is open on it. Public Wi-Fi often stops devices from seeing each other: try a phone hotspot instead.
%1$s did not answer. Open Diligent on it and try again.

Devices on the same network with Diligent open and visible.
Nobody nearby right now. Public Wi-Fi often hides devices from each other: a phone hotspot usually works.

Same Wi-Fi first, then phone to phone, then Tailscale.
Both devices on the same network or phone hotspot.
Works across networks when both devices use Tailscale.
A direct link between two Android phones, without Wi-Fi.
You will need to pair again before you can sync with it. Your files stay where they are on both devices.
Syncs after you save and every 10 minutes while both devices are reachable. Pauses when a file changed on both.
On the other device, open Devices, choose Add by QR code or IP address, and scan this code.
QR code to pair with this phone

Type the other device\'s IP address, like 192.168.1.20.
